reviewScope: ACT3_B005 replacement STILL_ONLY prompt and new isolated pilot plan

priorHumanDecision.reason: The composition, anonymous framing, office setting and banker action are acceptable. However, the generated identification card contains a visible portrait, readable text, numbers and official-looking marks. This violates the approved negative constraint against real IDs with readable information and creates unnecessary privacy and factual-authenticity risk.

rejectedPrompt.prompt: Medium shot of a customer's hands sliding a driver's license across a polished wood-grain desk surface toward a banker's hands positioned at a keyboard, banker beginning to type, neutral business casual attire visible on both figures from mid-torso down, no faces visible, generic computer monitor edge in frame, soft office lighting, clean professional desk surface
rejectedPrompt.negativePrompt: identifiable faces, real IDs with readable information, specific bank logos, branded materials, cluttered desk, unprofessional setting

proposedPrompt.prompt: Medium shot of a customer’s hands sliding a completely generic, unbranded identification card flat across a polished wood-grain desk toward a banker’s hands positioned at a keyboard. The banker is beginning to type. The card contains only abstract colour blocks and a simple faceless silhouette icon; it has no readable text, numbers, photograph, signature, barcode, seal, hologram, country mark or organisation mark. Neutral business-casual clothing is visible on both figures, framed below the shoulders with no faces shown. Generic computer-monitor edge in frame, soft office lighting and a clean professional desk.
proposedPrompt.negativePrompt: Readable text, numbers, personal information, realistic portrait photograph, signature, barcode, QR code, seal, hologram, government mark, country name, bank logo, branded materials, identifiable faces, cluttered desk, malformed hands.
